description: Default permissions for PrivacyNotes. The dialog and fs grants exist for the Markdown folder pillar, which picks a file or folder and then scans, reads, writes and renames plaintext notes inside it; every filesystem grant is scoped to $HOME, which the picker widens at runtime to whatever the user actually chose, and which a double-clicked file widens through take_pending_opens. `opener:allow-open-path` was granted here until 2026-08-14 for the row menu's Reveal in folder / Open in default app; both were removed as dead controls, so the grant went with them - nothing outside `openUrl` (covered by opener:default) uses the opener plugin now, and an unused path grant is ACL surface for no feature.
